Professional Summary: 
• Seasoned CX Solution Leader with 18 years of global experience in digital transformation across enterprise 
contact center and collaboration environments, delivering solutions across Healthcare, Banking, Consumer, 
Automotive and Logistics domains. 
• Strong experience in architecting and modernizing CX platforms like Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud, Cisco 
UCCE, Cisco IP Telephony and Microsoft Teams, with focus on customer journey and lifecycle management. 
• Currently leading enterprise CX architecture, working with business and pre-sales teams to understand 
customer challenges and design scalable, cost-effective solutions. 
• Hands-on experience in AI-driven CX including conversational IVR, omnichannel engagement, GenAI, 
sentiment analysis and automation to improve customer experience and operational efficiency. 
• Good exposure to solution consulting, RFP/RFI, cost-benefit analysis and stakeholder management across 
large transformation programs. 
 
Technical Expertise: 
• Global Contact Center: Lead architecture, modernization, and operations across Amazon Connect, Genesys 
Cloud, Cisco UCCE, MS Teams and UC platforms, driving enterprise-wide CX transformation initiatives. 
• Conversational IVR & Intelligent Routing Strategy: Define and govern IVR architecture, ACD routing models, 
and omnichannel engagement strategies to optimize customer journeys and operational efficiency. 
• AI-Driven CX Innovation: AI-powered self-service and automation strategies leveraging Amazon Lex, 
Dialogflow, and Copilot enterprise bot frameworks to enhance customer engagement and reduce 
operational cost. 
• Cloud Architecture & Enterprise Integration: Oversee AWS-native solution design and large-scale 
integrations with Salesforce, ServiceNow, WFM, and enterprise systems using serverless and API-driven 
frameworks. 
• Platform Modernization & Migration Governance: Lead legacy-to-cloud transformation programs as product 
owner, defining migration strategies from Cisco and Genesys environments to scalable CCaaS platforms. 
• Operational Excellence & Continuity Management: Ensure resilience, compliance, performance optimization, 
and seamless transition management across global contact center ecosystems. 
• Domain Expertise: Experience in designing CX solutions across Healthcare (Provider, Payer, Clinical Back 
Office, PBM and Healthcare Services), FMCG (customer support, order management, complaints & feedback 
handling), banking and Logistics (shipment tracking, delivery support, exception handling) using IVR, 
chatbots and omnichannel engagement 
 
 
Business & Strategic Capabilities: 
• Pre-Sales & Solutioning: 
Adept at crafting Business & customer-centric solutions during pre-sales, including Bill of Quantities (BoQ), 
Professional Services estimates, and Statements of Work (SOW). Experienced presentations and technical 
workshops. 
• Proposal Development & RFP/RFI Response: 
Strong background in leading the response to RFPs/RFIs, preparing technical proposals, cost estimates, and 
value propositions tailored to customer requirements. 
• Go-To-Market Strategy: 
Developed and executed strategies for CX and CCaaS offerings, including competitive analysis, customer 
engagement, and internal team enablement. 
• Channel Partnerships & Alliances: 
Built and nurtured strong relationships with technology OEM partners and vendors, ensuring strategic 
alignment and co-delivery of joint solutions. 

• Revenue Forecasting & AOP Planning: 
Contributed to business growth through effective revenue forecasting, pipeline management, and Annual 
Operating Plan (AOP) alignment with delivery capacity. 
• Cost/Benefit & ROI Modeling: 
Proficient in conducting financial modeling, including cost-benefit analysis and ROI assessments to support 
solution justification and investment planning.

Pepsico Global – Principal Architect, July 2022 – Till Date, Hyderabad 
 
Key Responsibilities & Achievements: 
Architecture & Technical Delivery 
• Prepare high-level architecture, solution designs, and technical roadmaps for Contact Center and 
communication platforms, including Amazon connect, Genesys Cloud and Go to market analysis for new 
roadmaps. 
• Lead solution design workshops with business stakeholders, capturing requirements and translating them 
into scalable and cost-effective solutions. 
• Ensure solutions adhere to enterprise standards, security, and regulatory compliance while delivering 
measurable business outcomes. 
Cloud & AI Innovation 
• Drive digital transformation through architected IVR call flows, conversational bot frameworks, and backend 
integrations with enterprise systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, Freshdesk, CETS, TMS, Arctree). 
• Design and deploy AI-powered automation using Amazon Lex, Genesys Bots, Salesforce Einstein Bot, and 
Google Dialogflow, covering conversational design, NLU configuration, and seamless agent handoff. 
• Build secure, scalable, and cost-optimized native architectures 
• Lead Conversational IVR strategy across voice and digital channels, enabling intelligent self-service and 
omnichannel engagement. 
Integrations & Customer Experience 
• Architect and implement integrations between Amazon Connect / Genesys Cloud and enterprise platforms 
including Salesforce (SCV) & Agent force CC with AC, ServiceNow, Freshdesk, WFM tools, and internal many 
applications systems. 
• Enhance agent productivity and customer experience through contextual routing, API-based integrations, 
and data-driven journey optimization. 
• Standardize reusable integration patterns and deployment frameworks for global rollouts. 
Strategic Engagement & Pre-Sales 
• Pre-sales initiatives by contributing to RFP/RFI responses, technical solution narratives, effort estimation, 
and architecture validation. 
• Develop Statements of Work (SOW), Level of Effort (LOE) estimates, and structured delivery plans aligned 
with business objectives. 
• Build customer-facing Proof-of-Concepts (POCs) and reusable demo environments showcasing AWS Contact 
Center capabilities. 
• Act as a trusted advisor to business and IT leadership, influencing CX strategy, cloud migration roadmaps, 
and long-term platform modernization. 
Leadership, Program & Project Management 
• Lead the Contact Center Engineering practice at PepsiCo Inc., overseeing program delivery, AOP, 
architecture, and Design and implementation of global cloud-based contact center solutions. 
• Manage a team of engineers, assigning tasks, conducting solution reviews, and driving delivery milestones to 
ensure on-time, high-quality outcomes. 
• Own end-to-end program and project delivery, from planning, estimation, and resource allocation to 
execution, rollout, risk management, and post-launch support. 
• Coordinate with cross-functional teams, vendors, and stakeholders to align delivery with business goals, 
budgets, timelines, and compliance requirements. 
Orange Business Services Pvt Ltd. (Subject Matter Expert, June 2017 – July 2022), Bangalore 
 
• Customer Experience (CX) Pre-Sales and Solution Consulting across platforms including Cisco UC/UCCE, 
Genesys Cloud CX, Amazon Connect , Enghouse and Microsoft Teams/Webex, guiding clients through 
transitions from legacy systems to modern cloud-based architectures. 
• Drove contact center transformation initiatives, supporting migrations from on-premises IP telephony to 
Genesys Cloud, Cisco Webex Contact Center, and Microsoft collaboration ecosystems. 
• Delivered digital transformation solutions for enterprise clients across pharmaceutical, transportation, oil & 
gas, and manufacturing sectors (e.g., BASF), aligning technology strategies with business goals. 
• Collaborated with ISPs, internal stakeholders, and customer teams to manage cutover planning and go-live 
execution, ensuring minimal disruption and smooth telecom transitions. 
• Managed relationships with third-party vendors, handling quotation processes, license procurement, and 
contract negotiations to enable timely, cost-efficient delivery of services. 
• Prepared Level of Effort (LOE) documents and contributed to Statements of Work (SOWs) based on client 
requirements and delivery expectations. 
• Led continuous improvement initiatives, identifying operational gaps, managing project risks, and leveraging 
tools and metrics to drive measurable enhancements. 
• Oversaw managed service provider (MSP) implementations, including OPEX/CAPEX hardware procurement, 
delivery tracking, and logistics coordination.
